title: Best of Switzerland & Italy | Roman Streets to Snowy Alps
highlights: Enjoy a ride to Mount Titlis in ROTAIR, the world's first cable car that revolves 360 degrees and offers a breathtaking view of the snow-clad Alps.
Walk on the highest-elevation suspension bridge in Europe, Titlis Cliff Walk, and enjoy the view of the most famous Titlis mountain in the world.
Float along narrow canals and hidden passages in a traditional gondola while admiring the beauty of one of Italy's most magical cities, Venice.
Be amazed by the magnificent beauty of Rhine Falls, the largest waterfall in Europe, and hear the mighty roar as you pass by it on a boat ride.
overview:
About the tour:
Visit some of Europe's most exciting and popular locations, making this vacation a dream come true. Rome, a city renowned for its rich history and culture as well as its culinary delights, is where you begin creating your story of Europe. After seeing the Colosseum, one of the wonders of the world, in Rome, you continue your European journey to Florence, the birthplace of the renowned Leonardo Da Vinci. Get the opportunity to see the Leaning Tower of Pisa, another global wonder, while in Florence. Then get ready to discover Switzerland's splendor. You will enter the realm of Narnia when you travel to Mount Titlis on Rotair. Witness the Rhine Falls and sense its fierce intensity, creating the image of dripping clouds. A trip to Europe isn't complete without beautiful souvenirs from the areas you visit, so make sure to bring home plenty of memorabilia as well as happy memories. 


Quick Info:
Destination Covered: Rome - Florence - Venice - Zurich
Duration: 9 Nights & 8 Days
Start Point: Leonardo da Vinci International Airport
End Point: Zurich Airport
inclusions: 2 nights stay in Rome with breakfast
Rome Hop On Hop Off Bus Tour - 24-Hour Classic Ticket
1 night stay in Florence with breakfast
2 nights stay in Venice with breakfast
Venice Gondola Ride Italy - Shared Gondola Ride with Guide
3 nights stay in Zurich with breakfast
Mount Titlis Tour, Switzerland - With Swiss Pass with Ice flyer
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Carry a form of identification, such as your passport or a government-issued ID as it may be required for certain activities or services.
Be mindful of local customs and traditions at each destination, including appropriate dress and behavior in religious sites.
Respect the environment and local communities by disposing of waste properly and supporting sustainable tourism initiatives.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the premises of attractions.
While credit cards are widely accepted, it's always a good idea to carry some cash, especially for small purchases and in more rural areas.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Rome | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Rome! Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check in. After that, spend the day at leisure or explore the city on your own by discovering some of its stunning sites, such as the Apostolic Palace, Domus Aurea Rome, and Trevi Fountain, among others. After a fun-filled day, return to the hotel on your own for the night.

days.title: Rome Hop On Hop Off Tour
days.desc: Explore the stunning city of Rome by taking a traditional hop-on, hop-off trip. To get on the Big Bus for your tour, arrive at the closest pickup location to your hotel. Take advantage of the hop-on/hop-off flexibility, which lets you tour the well-known neighborhoods and sites—such as the Colosseum, Roman ruins, Renaissance gardens, and many more—at your own pace. After that, make your own way back to the hotel.

items.title: Rome Hop On Hop Off Bus Tour - 24-Hour Classic Ticket

days.title: Transfer to Florence | Day at Leisure
days.desc: It's time to relocate from Rome, the Eternal City, to Florence, the home of the Renaissance.  Head to the Roma Termini station after checking out of the hotel & catch your train to Florence (train tickets included). Once you arrive at the Firenze S.M.N. Station, make way to the hotel and check in. Later, you can enjoy the time at leisure & visit sites such as the Square of Miracles, Villa Bardini, Pitti Palace and Uffizi Palace And Gallery.

days.title: Transfer to Venice | Venice Gondola Ride
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and make your own way to the Firenze S.M.N. station. Travel to Venice by train (train tickets included), and upon arrival at the Santa Lucia Station, head to the hotel for check in. Later, arrive at the Campiello Traghetto for a gondola ride through the city's iconic canals, passing under charming bridges nd beside historic palazzos. After the ride, visit popular places like St. Mark’s Bell Tower and San Giorgio Island.

items.title: Venice Gondola Ride Italy - Shared Gondola Ride with Guide

days.title: Day at Leisure in Venice
days.desc: Spend the day exploring Venice at your own pace. You can visit famous landmarks like the Rialto Bridge and Teatro La Fenice. You can also check out places like Ca’ D’Oro and the beautiful art at Scuola Grande di San Rocco. As evening sets in, you can enjoy a walk around the Venetian Arsenal. After a day full of discovery, make your way back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Zurich | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, travel to Zurich. Check out of the hotel and head to the Venice Santa Lucia Station to catch your train to Zurich (train tickets included). Upon arrival, activate your 4-day second-class Swiss Pass, which grants you unrestricted travel on the Swiss Travel System network. You can use the pass to get to the hotel and check in. Later, you can explore Zurich at your leisure, visiting locations such as Bürkliplatz and Uetliberg, among others.

days.title: Day Trip to Mount Titlis
days.desc: Today, head to Mt. Titlis, one of Switzerland’s most popular mountain destinations. Start by using your pass to reach Zürich Enge station and catch the train to Luzern. From there, continue your journey to Engelberg and hop on the ROTAIR, the world’s first revolving cable car. Once at the top, try thrilling experiences like the Cliff Walk or the Ice Flyer chair lift. After your adventure, make your way back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Mount Titlis Tour, Switzerland - With Swiss Pass with Ice flyer

days.title: Rhine Falls Boat Tour
days.desc: Prepare to be amazed by one of nature's most exquisite wonders: the Rhine Falls. Get to the Zurich train station and catch your train to Schaffhausen. After arriving, proceed to the pier at Schloss Laufen am Rheinfall and board the boat to view the Rhine Falls and the picturesque surroundings. Enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime experience as you pass directly through the falls. After that, make your own way back to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: It is time to bid farewell to incredible experiences. After checking out of the hotel, board your transfer with your Swiss pass to the airport so you can catch your flight home.
